entities.name: Killing of Salwan Momika
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: On 29 January 2025, Salwan Momika, an Iraqi refugee residing in Sweden known for controversial Quran burnings that sparked international diplomatic tensions, was fatally shot in Södertälje, Sweden. The shooting and subsequent police response occurred during a TikTok livestream, and occurred hours before a scheduled court verdict regarding his anti-Islamic demonstrations was to be announced.
